rationale: Compilation faithfully implements the reviewed design: seed_edits add title='Director of Engineering' to Robert Walsh and Nick Fury and title='Director of Marketing' to Morgan Freeman, consistent with the pre-existing user_teams roles (Robert and Morgan already admin, Nick and Artem already member) — no edits altered role assignments, only added the title attribute the design required. Bindings, selector filters (role=admin AND title='Director of Engineering' on the same user via user_teams.user_id join), and mechanical_checks.computed_matches=['U03ROBERT23'] with the three intended negatives (other_admin wrong title, title_match_member wrong role, plain_member fails both) all match the design's binding_note and roles exactly. The identifying path is a real USER↔WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP (user_teams) edge, not a fabricated relation, and answer_attributes (email/title/real_name) are legitimate bare columns available via users.info per the domain model's stored User attributes. No hidden-field, unsupported-capability, or table-name mismatch issues are present; the case remains a clean single-conjunction retrieval with well-constructed near-misses that block single-field shortcuts.
